question: Confluence of Bhagirathi and Alaknanda occur at ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Devaprayag.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The confluence of **Bhagirathi and Alaknanda** occurs at **Devaprayag,** which is located in the state of **Uttarakhand in India.**
 
• Devaprayag is also known as the **holy city **as it is the place where the two sacred rivers meet to form the holy river Ganges.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Vishnuprayag** is the confluence of Alaknanda and Dhauliganga rivers.
 
• **Nandaprayag** is the confluence of Alaknanda and Nandakini rivers.
 
• **Rudraprayag** is the confluence of Alaknanda and Mandakini rivers.
 
• Devaprayag is an important **pilgrimage site **and attracts a large number of **tourists and devotees **every year.
